text:
[name]
[email] · [phone] · [url]
Denver, CO

SUMMARY
Backend software engineer with five years of experience building messaging and billing services at Twilio. Go and Java, event-driven systems, PostgreSQL and Kafka. Looking for a senior backend role on a platform or infrastructure team.

EXPERIENCE

Twilio — Denver, CO
Software Engineer II, Messaging Platform · Apr 2024 – Present
• Own the message-status callback service that delivers delivery receipts to customer webhooks; handles about 1.2B callbacks per day across 3 regions.
• Reduced callback retry storms during carrier outages by adding per-customer adaptive backoff; peak retry volume during the two largest incidents of 2025 fell by roughly 60%.
• Led the migration of the service's state store from a sharded MySQL setup to DynamoDB over two quarters with no customer-visible downtime.
• On-call for the messaging platform tier; wrote 6 runbooks and the post-incident reviews for 4 SEV-2 incidents.
• Interview on the backend loop; have run about 40 coding interviews.
• Designed the callback service's regional failover: traffic drains to the nearest healthy region within 90 seconds, verified in quarterly game days.
• Cut the service's monthly infrastructure cost by about 22% by right-sizing the DynamoDB capacity mode and consolidating three idle Kafka consumer groups.
• Wrote the team's design-review template; it is now used across the four messaging platform teams.

Software Engineer, Billing Platform · Jun 2021 – Mar 2024
• Built the usage-aggregation pipeline (Kafka Streams, Java) that rolls up per-message usage records into hourly billing events; processes roughly 900M records per day.
• Fixed a double-counting bug under consumer rebalances that had been causing about $40k per month of credits; added idempotency keys and an end-to-end reconciliation job.
• Implemented tax-jurisdiction lookup for 11 new countries in the invoicing service.
• Added structured logging and tracing across the billing services, cutting mean time to identify the failing component from about 45 minutes to 10.
• Built the invoice-preview API used by the customer console; p99 latency under 400 ms for accounts with up to 5M monthly messages.
• Paired with the finance team on the month-end close runbook; the usage data reconciliation step dropped from 2 days to 4 hours.
• Mentored two new graduates during their first six months on the team.

Software Engineering Intern, Developer Tools · Jun 2020 – Aug 2020
• Shipped a CLI command for replaying webhook events to a local endpoint; included in the public CLI release that fall.
• Wrote the documentation page for the command; still the most-visited page in the CLI docs section.

EDUCATION
Purdue University — West Lafayette, IN
B.S. Computer Science, May 2021 · GPA 3.5/4.0
Teaching assistant, Data Structures (CS 251), two semesters
Relevant coursework: Operating Systems, Distributed Systems, Databases, Compilers

PROJECTS
• Open-source Go library for rate limiting with sliding-window and token-bucket strategies; about 300 stars, used by two internal Twilio services.
• Home lab: Kubernetes cluster on three mini PCs running a self-hosted observability stack.
• Talk at a regional Go meetup on backpressure in event pipelines (2025, about 80 attendees).

SKILLS
Go, Java, Python · Kafka, Kafka Streams, PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, Redis · AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker · gRPC, REST, OpenTelemetry, Datadog

CERTIFICATIONS
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (2023) · Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (2024)
